title: Gas explosion and fire in New York City apartment building kills 1, injures 14
summary: Fire department was responding to report of gas odor in Bronx building when explosion occurred during frigid night A gas explosion sent fire racing through the top floors of a high-rise apartment building in New York City early on Saturday, killing one person and injuring 14 others as temperatures plunged into the single digits overnight, authorities said. Firefighters responded shortly before 12.30am to the 17-story New York City housing authority (Nycha) building in the Bronx, where people were seen leaning out of windows calling for help as flames engulfed parts of the top floors, officials said. title: Six people injured after car crashes inside Detroit airport
summary: Driver was taken into custody after car crashed through airport entrance and struck Delta ticket counter A car crashed through the entrance of Detroit ’s metropolitan Wayne county airport on Friday evening, striking a ticket counter and injuring six people, airport officials said. The driver was taken into custody, the Wayne county airport authority (WCAA) said in a statement. The cause of the crash was not yet known, and airport police were investigating. Continue reading...

title: Gladys West, mathematician whose work paved the way for GPS, dies at 95
summary: A self-described "little farm girl" in the Jim Crow Era, Gladys West's complex and pioneering work for the U.S. Navy helped to improve billions of lives — and keep us from getting lost.

title: Trump Threatens 100% Retaliatory Tariffs Against Canada
summary: President Donald Trump threatened Canada with 100% tariffs against all its exports to the US if it makes a trade deal with China, escalating tensions between the US and its northern neighbor.
